name: Drift Orchard

do.objective: You have the fruit. They are awake. The vent to the north island is on the tree
The tree: the fruit is at the foot of the trunk, in the grove

intro.title: DRIFT ORCHARD
lines: The Vael grow their soldiers in orbit.
Nothing here has a floor it can hold on to.

outro: The gate takes you. Behind it the Gate itself is no longer a rumour.

messages.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE
messages.text: Calder, the Drift Orchard. The Vael grow Tollbearers in orbit. The moss has no grip at all: you will slide where you push. Landing is the whole art. The plates throw you across.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: It is ice with leaves on. Let go of the stick before you reach the edge, and let it carry you.

messages.speaker: SIGNAL HOUSE
messages.text: The great tree. The fruit is at its foot, in the grove, where there is grip. Take it and the whole bubble will know. The gate will not open for anything else.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: It is warm. They are all awake, now, and the flyers will come.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The glass is gone in the north. White light. The gate is on the far side of the north island.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The panel in the greenhouse wall rings hollow.

objective: The fruit hangs at the foot of the great tree in the middle. The gate is in the north, past the tree

quality.tallReason: the glass of the bubble is 20 m of living wall round the arena
quality.introduces: drift: a floor with almost no grip, so that you slide where you push and landing from a vent is an art
